'''2007 Kashyyyk Regionals Casey Anis LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2007 Kashyyyk Regionals]].

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
